scope: Normal ordering, two independent light mass sources, one-loop dimension-four Yukawa evolution and dimension-five operator evolution with tree matching at registered neutral thresholds, same three-family shooting and physical charged ports as 1702. Unified mu sign phase and real common-kernel |t| fixed by charged calibration. Oscillation angles are validation windows; cos(delta) is a phase-direction holdout, not an independent frequentist data combination.
